verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's first-party AI features docs say AI can write test cases automatically through its scripting capabilities, so the core capability is native and direct. The evidence does not show how the AI grounds those tests, such as reading the endpoint's OpenAPI spec or a captured response to build assertions. Missing for 10: documented generation from an API spec or actual responses, details of assertion depth and output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI generate test cases or assertions for an endpoint from its spec or responses

citations.quote: Use AI-powered features in Hoppscotch to rename requests, generate payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases automatically.
scripting capabilities for pre-request logic and test cases
